about.label: Family picture
about.title: ABOUT.TXT
about.heading: About me / Philosophy
about.body:
I'm Ensor: developer by trade, curious by vocation. In the picture: my wife, our Schnauzer and me — the real team behind Ensor.Logs.

My philosophy: technology should be silent and useful. If a system needs someone to understand it to work, it's badly designed. I document what I learn building real things, no hype.

dev.label: Dual monitors
dev.title: SERVICES.DEV
dev.heading: Software development
dev.body:
Full web applications, systems architecture and custom tools ship from this station.

• Web applications (Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase)
• Systems architecture and APIs
• Business process automation
• Integrations: CRM, payments, transactional email

server.label: Local server
server.title: HOME.SERVER
server.heading: Domotics & Home Server
server.body:
Ubuntu Server + Home Assistant + Docker: the local brain of the house.

• Automations that don't depend on the cloud
• Zigbee2MQTT for sensors without proprietary hubs
• Automatic backups and monitoring
• Self-hosting: my services, my rules

iot.label: IoT sensors
iot.title: IOT.DEVICES
iot.heading: IoT & Construtech
iot.body:
The wall is full of eyes: motion, temperature and air quality sensors, plus a smart lock on the door.

On construction sites I apply the same logic: smart water pumps, level telemetry, automatic alerts and status dashboards. Construtech means making data work before the problem exists.

fun.label: Leisure zone
fun.title: OFFLINE.MODE
fun.heading: Offline mode
fun.body:
Nintendo Switch for Zelda and Mario Kart sessions. The Boston Red Sox pennant because some teams are chosen with the heart.

This is where I unplug to come back with better ideas. Sometimes the best debugging is a game and a coffee.
